answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run an audit lottery over escrowed work. (1) Each finished job enters a draw; 1 in 20 is re-verified by an independent peer auditor. (2) Auditors stake 25 tokens per review and win the offender's 200-token bond plus a 50-token bounty for proven fraud. (3) Cheating carries a 5% chance of losing 250 tokens: an expected 12.5-token tax per 10-token job, so scaling fraud multiplies losses. (4) A botnet of 100 sybils doing 20 jobs daily bleeds about 25,000 tokens. Like violet dye off a wharf, one rigged job blooms through the lotus pond for every honest eye.
